chunks: Beware! Satan has collected his group and assembled his horse-men and foot-soldiers.
Surely, with me is my sagacity. I have neither deceived myself nor ever been deceived.
By Allāh I shall fill to the brim for them a cistern from which I alone would draw water. They can neither turn away from it nor return to it.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Imam Ali's claim to the Cistern (Al-Hawd) in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this passage from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) addresses the political and spiritual mobilization of his rivals, Talha and Zubayr, framing their uprising as a manifestation of Satan's forces. He asserts his unique spiritual authority and clarity, promising that he will personally guard the Cistern (Al-Hawd) on the Day of Judgment, ensuring that those who deviate from the true path will not be able to return to it. This declaration underscores the Shia belief in the Imam's role as the intercessor and gatekeeper of salvation, distinguishing his station from that of the general community.
